matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 100th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here we are at the crossroads of Week 2, and frankly, this matchup has all the makings of a statement game. Pittsburgh's pass defense grades 71st—a full standard deviation below our offense's elite 100th percentile ranking—which means Drake Maye and company have the statistical green light to operate with impunity through the air, assuming we can maintain last week's mojo. The Steelers' recent form (0.02 net EPA/play over their last three games) suggests they're treading water, which is exactly when a hungry Patriots home crowd at Gillette can impose its will. Yes, we're laying 5.5 points, but with an O/U of just 41.5, this figures to be a chess match—and our rook appears far better positioned than theirs this Sunday at 1 PM ET.
